definitions.gloss: riverbed; dry stony area beside a river
definitions.explanation: The flat, often rocky or sandy area along a river that is dry except during high water. A popular spot for picnics, fireworks, and camping in Japan.

examples.english: I played down by the river.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}には{河原|かわら}でバーベキューをする。
examples.english: In summer we do barbecues on the riverbed.

examples.japanese: {河原|かわら}にはごろごろと{大|おお}きな{石|いし}が{転|ころ}がっていた。
examples.english: Big rocks were scattered all over the riverbed.

notes:
Written {河原|かわら} or {川原|かわら}; both readings are かわら and refer to the same thing. Distinct from the homophone {瓦|かわら} (roof tile).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {河原|かわら}の{石|いし}: stones on the riverbed
- {河原|かわら}で{遊|あそ}ぶ: to play by the river
- {河原|かわら}で{花火|はなび}をする: to set off fireworks at the riverbed
- {河原|かわら}{沿|ぞ}い: along the riverbed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {川岸|かわぎし}: riverbank — the edge/border of the river, not the dry stony zone
- {河川敷|かせんしき}: river floodplain — formal/administrative term for the same area
